original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: Determine the exact arbitrary-positive destination-row tariff and complete 22-vector Pareto frontier for demand (110,101,011) over F2^3; extend the proof to zero-sum triples with pairwise incomparable principal ideals over any commutative unital Boolean ring.
scope_change_reason: The donor explicitly assigned the principal-ideal Boolean triple left open by #5259. This is an algebraic side result, not an H2/K replacement or a physical bit-supplier expansion.
bottleneck_link: Supplies a complete abstract dirty-input cost and all-word lower bound. Physical source access, coefficient production, routing, precision, stock and supplier interfaces still need separate accounting; no new kappa.
stop_rule: Finish a self-contained lower bound with a construction for every necessary price term, or record the precise unresolved branch. Bound corroboration to three small Boolean rings and seven independent shortest-path price cases.
evidence: README.md proves the all-word 22-term optimum, exact count-vector frontier, strict exposure and Boolean-ring extension. verify.py checks 456 demands, 10032 words, 80256 formal forward/inverse column checks, 180224 literal input checks, all 22 strict price witnesses, 11 controls and seven independent full-state shortest paths settling 314361 states. Finite evidence corroborates the written proof; independent human review and proof-kernel acceptance are unclaimed.
author: lee-phys, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in source inspection, derivation, proof, implementation, exact experiments, validation and writing. No subagents or independent reviewers were used.

open_questions.question: What is the exact tariff for (110,101,011) over F2^3 with independent positive prices on the six directed ADD edges?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The destination-only frontier loses parent identities and does not price arbitrary routing.
open_questions.first_step: Probe cheap directed cycles with full dirt tracking and compare them with all row-labeled seven-gate one-insertion words.
open_questions.blocked_by: The incoming-row return lemma is not a per-edge bound; aggregate destination counts cannot supply the required edge-sensitive lower bound.

open_questions.question: What is the exact destination-row tariff for demand (1,2,4) over F2^3?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This incomparable principal-ideal triple has no zero-sum relation; source-insertion feasibility is known from #5266 but total tariff is not established here.
open_questions.first_step: Find the least-ADD source-column conjugations from a unit insertion and classify multi-insertion support with all original dirt columns retained.
open_questions.blocked_by: The present zero-sum words and three-atom demand pattern do not apply. A new matching count classification is needed.
